dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: HC total inferred as 560 (448 train + 112 held-out test); same HC cohort used for spectral power and functional connectivity models.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "We develop an end-to-end NM framework of a normative HD-EEG cohort comprising 560 healthy subjects"; "Models were trained on 448 (52% M) healthy controls (HC) and 112 (55% M) healthy subjects were held out"; "we have developed models for the normative trajectories of these two wellestablished sets of features"

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Train-phase derived from 448 HC with 52% M (female inferred). Overall-phase inferred by summing train and held-out test (112 with 55% M).
